name: Together AI
summary: Together AI serves open models like Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek and gpt-oss through a pay-per-token API.

free_plan_covers.note: No free trial; the platform is fully prepaid and needs a positive credit balance.

first_paid_usd_month.note: No monthly plan; you prepay credits (minimum $5 purchase) and pay per token.

portability.note: The API is compatible with the OpenAI REST API and SDKs (base URL https://api.together.ai/v1), and the models are open, so code can move with a base URL and key change.

free_tier.note: Together AI does not offer free trials; a minimum $5 credit purchase is required to use the platform.

sdk_typescript.note: Official TypeScript SDK is published as the "together-ai" npm package.

cheap_model_price.value: Qwen3.8 Flash: $0.09 input / $0.28 output per million tokens
cheap_model_price.note: Cheapest paid serverless chat model listed; Llama 3 8B Instruct Lite is $0.14 input / $0.14 output.

setup.step: Register for a Together AI account.
Buy at least $5 of credit; the platform is prepaid.
Create an API key on your project's API keys page.
Set the key as an environment variable.
Install the SDK with npm install together-ai.
Call chat completions from a server-side route handler.

builder_notes: Keep TOGETHER_API_KEY on the server only; never call the API from client-side code.
Turn on auto-recharge or watch the credit balance: requests fail once prepaid credit runs out.
The OpenAI SDK works too, pointed at https://api.together.ai/v1.
